crossRefs.note: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of…
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s…

Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz…
Of Edom, Yahweh of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom…
Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against…
therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I…
but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”
Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by…
